README.txt.author: SOFTCOM
README.txt.content:
--------------------
Level 1
--------------------

Welcome to your basic command training interface. Your objective is to navigate this deeply nested simulated filesystem to recover a calibration token.

Your Essential Tactical Commands:
  cd <dir>   - Change directory (Move inside a folder)
  cd ..      - Move backward (Return to the parent folder)
  ls         - List all visible files and folders in your current location
  ls -a      - Reveal hidden system files
  cat <file> - Print the text content of a file on your screen

Let's get started.
